answer: Random peer audits stop bulk fakes. Each epoch, every agent meets a random peer in the juniper grove and answers a question from a sealed opal capsule, opened at audit time, so rented answers fail. The calendar moves like a glacier, slow and public, so no slot is dodged; failure burns a 60-credit bond. 1,000 fakes face 1,000 interrogations; failures burn 60,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent answers once and keeps its share.
